# Nexvyn OS SDK

> Public app-developer kit for Nexvyn OS: scripts (Lua, JavaScript, Python, C script) and native C/C++ modules, with
> templates, headers, tools and guides. Current: SDK 1.16, Native SDK 1.2, native ABI v1 (`VERSION.json`). Paths are
> relative to the `SDK/` folder. Start with `AI_GUIDE.md`. Do not invent APIs: a name that is not in
> `Reference/SDK.md` or a header does not exist. Vulkan for native apps is on by default since 1.4.0 (when the driver check at start passes):
> check `NXN_CAP_VULKAN` at run time and fall back to GL. Documentation is English; apps must ship eight locales
> (en, tr, de, es, fr, ja, ko, zh).

## Start here

- [AI_GUIDE.md](AI_GUIDE.md): operational manual for AI agents: runtime choice, toolchain, manifest, build, package, test, localization, input, graphics, limits, debugging, Store, common errors
- [README.md](README.md): human overview of the kit, starting points and product contracts
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): SDK-facing changes since Nexvyn OS 1.3.0
- [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md): version identity of the kit and what it contains
- [VERSION.json](VERSION.json): machine-readable versions: os, sdk, native, nativeAbi, requiredLocales

## Reference

- [Reference/SDK.md](Reference/SDK.md) (SDK 1.16 adds `update` returning false to idle, `ui.requestFrame()`, `touches` and `input.touches()` for Lua, JavaScript, Python `"python3"`): complete script SDK contract: package layout, app.json, lifecycle, gfx, ui, nxui, input, fs, net, sys, audio, g3d, nexvyn.game, phys, nav, per-language sections
- [Reference/c/include/nexvyn.h](Reference/c/include/nexvyn.h): C-script SDK header (TinyCC runtime); the other headers in that folder are the freestanding C library
- [Reference/java/](Reference/java/): Java SDK base classes (nexvyn.App and bindings) for the Java runtime

## Tools

- [Tools/nxv/nxv.py](Tools/nxv/nxv.py): CLI: new, create, check, build, pack, icon, install, push
- [Tools/nxv/nxv_i18n.py](Tools/nxv/nxv_i18n.py): eight-locale checker and pseudo-localizer: --check <bundle>, --pseudo <text>
- [Tools/nxv/nxv_create.py](Tools/nxv/nxv_create.py): N2 project creator with runtime recommendation (nxv.py create)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/tools/nxv_native/](Languages/c/native-kit/tools/nxv_native/): native CLI: new, build, lib, check-lib, check-win, check-design, shader, package, run, symbolize, doctor
- [Languages/c/native-kit/tools/toolchain.json](Languages/c/native-kit/tools/toolchain.json): pinned devkitPro package versions
- [Languages/c/native-kit/tools/design_check.py](Languages/c/native-kit/tools/design_check.py): OS design-rule checker for ImGui apps
- [Languages/c/native-kit/tools/nxvapp_pack.py](Languages/c/native-kit/tools/nxvapp_pack.py): package packer and verifier (--verify)

## Native headers (Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/)

- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexvyn_native.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexvyn_native.h): single include for the whole nxn_* API; ABI v1
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_base.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_base.h): base types, result codes, NXN_STRUCT_INIT
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_app.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_app.h): lifecycle (nxn_init, nxn_run, nxn_should_quit), capability bits NXN_CAP_*, nxn_caps_get, nxn_info_get
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_caps.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_caps.h): header-only capability query helper (nxn_capability_query)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_display.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_display.h): display: GL core or GLES context, swap, resize, nxn_display_proc
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_event.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_event.h): event queue: resize, quit, focus, dock, suspend, resume, theme, menu, power, language
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_input.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_input.h): controller, touch (up to 16 with stable id), USB keyboard and mouse, text
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_audio.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_audio.h): audio stream, OS mixer effects and tones
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_fs.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_fs.h): app data, cache and bundle folders; recoverable writes
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_sys.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_sys.h): time, threads, thread hints, logging, permissions, notify, clipboard, rumble, picker, save backups, memory budget
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_ui.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_ui.h): OS look tokens, system fonts, icon names, nxn_tr translated texts
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_os_ui.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_os_ui.h): OS design system and widget kit for Dear ImGui (frame layer, nxn_os_* widgets)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui.h): Dear ImGui font helper
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui_input.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui_input.h): shared native UI input backend for ImGui
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_scroll_physics.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_scroll_physics.h): shared kinetic scrolling math (header-only)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_nxui.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_nxui.h): retained semantic UI (not painted in a GL window)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_menu.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_menu.h): window menu in the OS menu bar
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_window.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_window.h): window title, mode and modified mark (Native 1.2)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_power.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_power.h): battery, charger, dock and network state (Native 1.2)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_dialog.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_dialog.h): OS alert, question and text prompt (Native 1.2)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_lib.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_lib.h): shared libraries (.nxvlib): nxn_lib_open
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_jit.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_jit.h): JIT code memory, fault handler, guard pages (off by default)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_stream.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_stream.h): streaming reads of big files through a shared block cache
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_phys.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_phys.h): 3D collision (SDK 1.15)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_nav.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_nav.h): 3D navigation (SDK 1.15)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_port_input.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_port_input.h): universal port input: gamepad, multi-touch gestures, mouse, keyboard
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexgfx_native.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexgfx_native.h): ngfx_* baked 3D scene renderer
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexgfx_backend.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nexgfx_backend.h): host table behind ngfx_*
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_vk.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_vk.h): Vulkan availability helper
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui_vk.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_imgui_vk.h): Dear ImGui Vulkan backend glue (opt-in at build time)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_provider.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_provider.h): runtime provider ABI v1
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_app_api.h](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/include/nexvyn/nxn_app_api.h): generated app API table (do not edit)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/toolchain/nxn_abi_v1.json](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/toolchain/nxn_abi_v1.json): the frozen ABI v1 surface (add-only)
- [Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/toolchain/nxwin_imports.txt](Languages/c/native-kit/sdk/native/toolchain/nxwin_imports.txt): every host import a windowed module may use
